fuel_consumption.source_quote: Fuel consumption not explicitly stated in millions of gallons in item7a. Swap agreements covered ~30% of 2002 projected fuel requirements.

instrument_type_details.notes: Swap agreements with Enron as counterparty. Enron filed for bankruptcy December 2001 making counterparty collection uncertain. Also had fixed-price fuel supply contracts treated as normal purchases under SFAS 133 (not financial derivatives) covering ~32% of consumption through March 2002 at ~$0.69/gal.
